newsitem.title: FRANCE: FRENCH SOCCER STAR LOKO TO COMPENSATE POLICE.
newsitem.headline: FRENCH SOCCER STAR LOKO TO COMPENSATE POLICE.

text.p: A Paris court on Wednesday ordered French soccer international Patrice Loko to pay 22,000 francs ($3,800) in damages to a dozen police he insulted after they arrested him for running amok two years ago.
The court said it would wait until September 3, after Loko had paid up, to announce its full verdict.
A state prosecutor has asked the court to give the 27-year-old Paris-Saint-Germain forward a suspended eight-month sentence on charges of indecent exposure and damaging property.
Loko ran amok two years ago, kicking cars outside a Paris nightclub, spitting and pouring abuse at police who arrested him and repeatedly exposing his genitals to a policewoman.

At the hearing two weeks ago, policemen testified that Loko made disparaging comparisons between their salaries and his huge income, and boasted that highly-placed friends would rapidly get him out of the police station.
An embarrassed Loko apologised and said he did not remember anything from what French media called his "crazy night".
Tests showed he had not consumed any alcohol or taken any drugs, and the prosecutor said the death of his young son three years earlier could explain his behaviour.
